༄༅/ /tshe'i dbang bskur zab mo bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshe'i dbang bskur zab mo bzhugs so//

bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir byin rlabs bya bar 'dod na/ las gzhung bsrangs te gnas dben par rdul tshon dmar pos padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsis bkang ba'i dbus su/ tshe ril slob ma'i grangs can blugs pa'i kha me long dang dar dmar gyis bkab pa'i steng du gzung thag btags la bzhag /de'i shar du tshe gtor zlum po bris skus brgyan pa dang shel rdo/ lhor gtso bum dang tshe'i mda' dar/ nub tu chang phud dang dri'i chu/ byang du slob dpon gyi yo byad dang rdo rje dril bu dang las bum rnams bkod/ mthar mchod pas bskor la bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed gzhung ltar bsgrubs shing bsnyen sgrub dzab la 'bad/ de nas slob ma rnams la las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad cing gral du 'khod la maṇḍal phul te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// sogs gsum dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags gsum bya/ de nas thog mar byang sgo'i las bum gyis khrus sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐ */ dri ma rnam drug sbyang ba'i phyir// yan lag brgyad ldan lha yi chu// de ring khyod*/la sbyin par bya/ /sdig sgrib bag chags ngan pa kun/ /byang zhing dag pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces sbyin no/ /las gzhung ltar mngon rtogs kyi dmigs pa sprad la rol mo bya/ de nyid mi nyams pa'i phyir yi ge gsum bzla zhing*/ nub sgo'i dri chus gnas gsum du thig le bya/ de nas dbang dngos gzhi'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyi// ma lus bka' drin stsal du gsol| |zhes gsol ba btab la/ lho sgo'i bum pas dbang bskur zhing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi sogs brjod/

des sku'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /tshe dpag med kyi sku bsgom pa la dbang ngo*// zhes don bshad/ nub sgo'i chang phud sbyin zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs pa'i// ma lus ngo bo a mṛ ta// skal ldan bu la sbyin par bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka a bhi sogs dang*/ des gsung gi dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /tshe dpag med kyi gzungs sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ zhes don bshad/ shar sgo'i shel rdos dbang bskur zhing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs ni dri ma med// sgrib bral gsal dwangs mnyam nyid spros dang bral// phyi nang gnyis med don dam thig le'i dbang*// skal ldan bu mchog khyed kyis rtogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta a bhi sogs/ des thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /tshe dpag med kyi ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bsgom pa la dbang ngo*// zhes don bshad/ shar sgo'i tshe gtor mgor bzhag la| hūm̐ */ tshe zan dngos grub sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i gter// mi 'dzad longs spyod ldan pa'i bang mdzod de// spyad na bskal pa stong gi tshe yang sring*// skal ldan bu mchog khyod la sbyin par bya| |zhes gzungs sngags brjod/ de nas tshe dbang dngos ni/ slob ma rnams slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor gsum dang phyag gsum 'tshal bcug la/ sngags kyis gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ na mo buddhā ya sogs gzhung ltar rjes zlos bya| dmigs pa 'bog pa ni/ slob dpon tshe dpag med gsal ba'i thugs ka nas tshe dpag med tshon gang ba zhig rgyang nge thon te mdun gyi tshe chang ril bu dang bcas pa la thim zhing de dag lce thog tu slebs pa tsam gyis khyed rang gi tshe nyams pa/ brkus pa/ yal ba/ gas pa/ zhig pa/ ral ba/ 'thor ba/ chag pa rnams dang*/ sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i tshe thung ba'i mtshan ma yod pa de dag rab tu zhi nas/

tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje/ mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung*/ mi nub pa rgyal mtshan du byas te/ 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad cing dkyil 'khor steng gi tshe dpag med dang*/ thod chang nang gi tshe ril dang tshe chang sbyin/ de nas/ rgya gar nas byon pa'i sogs gzhung ltar smon lam tshar gsum brjod du 'jug go| |de nas de dag mi nyams pa'i phyir rgyas gdab pa ni/ lho sgo'i tshe mda' thogs te/ slob ma'i spyi bor rgya gram du reg cing*/ hūm̐ ā yuḥ 'chi med snang ba mtha' yas tshe yi bdag /rdo rje slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la/ /tshe yi dngos grub rgya chen stsal ba 'dis// mi shigs mi 'gyur sra brtan rdo rje ltar// 'jig med mda' dar rgya gram rgya yis thob// tshe la bar chad med par mdzad du gsol| |zhes brjod/ de ltar dbang rnams rdzogs par mnos pa'i dam tshig tu lus kyi sgo nas khams drug ldan pa'i mi nas mdor na srog chags grog sbur tsam yang srog mi gcod pa dang*/ ngag gi sgo nas srog gcod pa dag chod cig ces bsgo ba dang*/ srog bcad pa la legs so zhes brjod pa dang*/ yid kyi sgo nas gzhan gyis srog bcad pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ 'di dag ni srog gcod do zhes snyam pa dang*/ bcad na snyam pa'i 'dun pa spangs shing*/ tshe dpag med 'di nyid kyi gzungs la 'bad par byas na tshe'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ gnas skabs su tshe'i bar chad zhi zhing bsam pa 'grub/ mthar thug mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang thob par nges pas de ltar khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma lus pa srog la bab kyang bsrung snyam du bsam la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ rjes su tshe lha mchod cing bstod la/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs nas/ gshegs gsol sogs sgrub thabs ltar bya zhing*/

gtor ma sogs dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad rnams dngos grub tu rol zhing bya khyi la sbyin par mi bya'o// zhes tshe dbang zab khyad can 'di nyid kyang byang gnam mtsho'i bkra shis do bo cher 'khrul snang du byung ba cung zad zin bris bgyis kyang rgyud ngal gyi dbang du lus pas slar yang bla ma dro skyid kyis nan cher bskul ba'i ngor/ dbu ru stod kyi dge slong dharma kīrtis gzhu spro lung gi pho brang lcang lo can du bris pa'o// dge bar gyur cig/ //
